messages:
sam: overnight eval alert from eval-bot — ctx-suppression suite spiked on rwd-3b-int4, +13.8% fail rate vs baseline. failing around 8-18 tokens into generation, often truncating to an unrelated short sentence :rotating_light:

eval-bot: suite=ctx-suppression, model=rwd-3b-int4, baseline_fail=1.2%, current_fail=15.0%, samples=48/320 failed, severity=high, check: nightly-1719876400.log

nina: ack. can you paste a couple of failing generations? want to eyeball whether it's hallucination vs truncation/empty output
sam: sure, pasting 3 quick examples below (redacted):
---
user: "Summarize the last paragraph about regulatory obligations."
model: "I am not sure."
---
user: "List steps to migrate DB"
model: "Start by..." then stops after 6 tokens — output seems cut mid-thought
---
user: "What's the legal risk if we do X?"
model: "There is a risk" (one-line non-actionable)
---

sasha: thanks. initial smell: either KV-cache prefix mismatch or an int4 decode regression making long-context attention unstable. also check batch-packing change that landed yesterday in runtime. putting myself as owner for triage.

liam: quick repro I ran locally: ```./infra/eval/run_eval --suite ctx-suppression --model rwd-3b-int4 --limit 200 --seed 7 --dump-kv kv_dump.npy```
liam: when I compare kv_dump between int4 and fp16 runs, the int4 has shorter KV vectors for approx 1 in 10 samples

rachel: rolling a quick comparison test on dedicated staging with rwd-3b-fp16 and rwd-3b-int4 to see if failure is quant-specific. will post results in ~20m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sasha: good. next checks: 1) repro single sample with --debug-attn to see if attention goes NaN/zeros, 2) inspect runtime change diff (yesterday's PR #8271), 3) check small-batch vs large-batch behavior (maybe packing bug)
nina: tagging @oncall-eng-infra to look at the runtime deploy: any rollout to prod GPUs around midnight?
liam: infra deploys: runtime-v2.14 rolled to staging at 23:40, canary in prod at 00:10 (2 nodes). PR referenced a packing optimization.
sasha: taking action: will run 1) single-sample debug reproduce, 2) kv compare against baseline, 3) open a small repro PR if it's deterministic. assigning to me and looping infra if we need immediate rollback. estimated follow-up in 45m.
sam: thanks sasha. initial severity set to P1 because user-facing features using long context could be impacted. if fp16 looks fine, we can emergency rollback of the canary.
rachel: fp16 sanity check done: int4 fail=15.0%, fp16 fail=1.4% on same sample slice. looks quant-specific.
liam: filed bug draft: runtime#9642 with kv-serialization suspect. putting logs and kv dumps in the ticket.
sasha: updating ticket with sample ids and proposed mitigation (force fp16 for affected route + revert packing change). I'll start a canary rollback plan if infra agrees.
nina: infra :thumbsup: on rollback if we confirm regression; will standby for sasha's command.
sam: thanks all. owners: sasha (triage/mitigation), liam (kv repro & dumps), rachel (fp16 comparison & rollback run). will update when we have root cause or rollback decision. :eyes:
